@@ D01 add fk not valid set null on registered col
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT fk1 FOREIGN KEY (ar) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (id) ON DELETE SET NULL NOT VALID
@@ D02 validate
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk1
@@ D03 add column with references set null (Q7-3)
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD COLUMN ar text REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
@@ D04 on update set default
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT fk1 FOREIGN KEY (ar) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (id) ON UPDATE SET DEFAULT
@@ D05 fk on referencing side new table -> repos cascade (does not write repos)
CREATE TABLE aveloxis_data.newkid (id int, rid int REFERENCES aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
@@ D06 fk on delete cascade FROM repos to other (deletes repos rows)
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT fk1 FOREIGN KEY (ar) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
@@ D07 fk multi-col with set null (col list) other col only
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT fk1 FOREIGN KEY (ar, fe) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (a, b) ON DELETE SET NULL (fe)
@@ D08 fk multi-col set null col list ar
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT fk1 FOREIGN KEY (zz, fe) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (a, b) ON DELETE SET NULL (zz)
@@ D09 truncate kid's parent cascade: lone (no refs) CASCADE
TRUNCATE aveloxis_data.lone CASCADE
@@ D10 truncate other (Table()-declared only) cascade
TRUNCATE aveloxis_data.other CASCADE
@@ D11 truncate kid cascade

@@ D12 truncate table then registered refs added in same text
CREATE TABLE aveloxis_data.t1 (id int primary key);
@;
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT f FOREIGN KEY (zz) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.t1 (id);
@;
TRUNCATE aveloxis_data.t1 CASCADE
@@ D13 truncate restart identity cascade w/ ONLY
TRUNCATE ONLY aveloxis_data.lone RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE
@@ D14 drop table parent cascade where registered inherits? (drop other cascade)
DROP TABLE aveloxis_data.other CASCADE
@@ D15 drop table of partitioned parent whose partition is... registered is child: CREATE repos as partition recorded? 
DROP TABLE aveloxis_data.lone
@@ D16 detach concurrently
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos DETACH PARTITION aveloxis_data.repos_p1 CONCURRENTLY
@@ D17 no inherit
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos NO INHERIT aveloxis_data.other
@@ D18 other no inherit repos
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.other NO INHERIT aveloxis_data.repos
@@ D19 cluster / vacuum full / reindex
CLUSTER aveloxis_data.repos USING repos_pkey;
@;
VACUUM FULL aveloxis_data.repos;
@;
REINDEX TABLE aveloxis_data.repos
@@ D20 alter constraint deferrable
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ALTER CONSTRAINT fk1 DEFERRABLE

@@ D32 temp same text
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int); INSERT INTO tmp_x VALUES (1); UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D33 temp named repos shadows registered: unqualified write
CREATE TEMP TABLE repos (repo_id int, ar text); UPDATE repos SET ar = ar
@@ D34 temp after write
UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2; CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int)
@@ D35 temp dropped before write
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int); DROP TABLE tmp_x; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D36 temp in other statement text
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int)
@;
UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D37 pg_temp.x undeclared
UPDATE pg_temp.tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D38 temp ON COMMIT DROP then commit in same text
BEGIN; CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int) ON COMMIT DROP; COMMIT; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D39 CREATE TEMP IF NOT EXISTS (may not be the one made: a permanent tmp_x on search path? no: temp first)
CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_x (id int); UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D40 temp rolled back
BEGIN; CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int); ROLLBACK; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D41 temp renamed away then written
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int); ALTER TABLE tmp_x RENAME TO tmp_y; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D42 temp created AS SELECT / INTO TEMP
SELECT 1 AS id INTO TEMP tmp_x; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D43 temp view over registered then written (view is not table kind)
CREATE TEMP VIEW tv AS SELECT * FROM aveloxis_data.repos; UPDATE tv SET ar = ar
@@ D44 temp table INHERITS registered
CREATE TEMP TABLE tk () INHERITS (aveloxis_data.repos); UPDATE tk SET ar = ar
@@ D45 temp table partition of registered
CREATE TEMP TABLE tk PARTITION OF aveloxis_data.repos DEFAULT; INSERT INTO tk (ar) VALUES ($1)
@@ D46 temp created in DO, written at top
DO $$ BEGIN CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int); END $$; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D47 temp table LIKE registered, ar AlwaysRefresh from itself (fine)
CREATE TEMP TABLE tk (LIKE aveloxis_data.repos); UPDATE tk SET ar = ar
@@ D48 temp explicit schema pg_temp create then bare write
CREATE TABLE pg_temp.tmp_x (id int); UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D49 temp with schema-qualified aveloxis_data.tmp? cannot. temp set then set search_path
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_x (id int); SET search_path = aveloxis_data; UPDATE tmp_x SET id = 2
@@ D50 temp, then ATTACH it as partition to registered
CREATE TEMP TABLE tk (repo_id int, ar text); ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ATTACH PARTITION tk DEFAULT; INSERT INTO tk (ar) VALUES ($1)
@@ D51 temp, then ALTER tk INHERIT registered
CREATE TEMP TABLE tk (repo_id int, ar text); ALTER TABLE tk INHERIT aveloxis_data.repos; UPDATE tk SET ar = ar
@@ D52 temp then FROM temp reading target for AR
CREATE TEMP TABLE tk AS SELECT repo_id, ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = tk.ar FROM tk WHERE tk.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ D53 unlogged table as scratch copy for AR (catalog knows)
CREATE TABLE aveloxis_data.scratch AS SELECT repo_id, ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = s.ar FROM aveloxis_data.scratch s WHERE s.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ D54 INSERT SELECT * from target into registered
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos SELECT * FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@@ D55 alter table add constraint fk on kid referencing repos ON UPDATE CASCADE (writes kid, not registered)

@@ D56 partition of with FK col action
